$meta.title: Taxonomies registry — the tree of problem-collection taxonomies
$meta.purpose: The single entry point to every collection taxonomy. Each collection has a JSON taxonomy = a zoom-out index of its attempts; this file registers them so the tree itself is navigable as collections come and go. Load THIS first, then the collection taxonomy, then its `detail` leaves — three zoom levels.
$meta.how_to_use: Pick a collection by `status`/`one_line`; open its `taxonomy`; scan that file's category one-liners for the 50,000-ft shape; follow a `detail` pointer to the leaf md for full reasoning.
$meta.modularity: Collections are independent registry entries. To add one: author a *_taxonomy.json (per TAXONOMY_SCHEMA.md) and add a row here. To re-parent material across collections as abstraction levels shift, move entries between taxonomies by `id` and update cross-links — no prose rewrite. Entries reference each other across collections via [[file-stem]] wiki-links and shared `id`s, so the tree mutates without breaking references.
$meta.corpus_spine: papers/spine/ (umbrella note, 5pp): reads the 4-paper corpus as one classification via the filtration S⊇S_σ⊇S_df; its architectural claims (quarantine theorem + tame tower + two-gap ladder) are PROVED as of 2026-07-08. Reference-only. Open bridging conjecture = latticehood family.
